list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: An ingestion task id; the admin console fills it to show one run.

list.name: temporal_ui
list.description: Temporal UI base URL for the run links; the same value as HARBORRAG_TEMPORAL_UI_URL.

list.name: Deploys
list.expr: count by (job, service_version) (target_info) unless count by (job, service_version) (last_over_time(target_info[1d] offset 5m))

links.title: Runbooks
links.tooltip: What each alert means and how to respond

links.title: Temporal: this run
links.tooltip: The run's source workflow; set the Run variable first

panels.title: Oldest source lag
panels.description: Time since the least recently synced source last completed a run, fully or partly, and how many sources never have. Orange after a day, red after 26 hours: Last sync per source and tenant, below, names the source.

targets.expr:
count(max by (tenant, source_scope_id) (harborrag_ingestion_source_last_success_timestamp_seconds{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector"}) == 0)
or count(max by (tenant, source_scope_id) (harborrag_ingestion_source_last_success_timestamp_seconds{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector"})) * 0

panels.title: Failed documents
panels.description: Documents whose ingestion failed in the last 24 hours. A lower bound: failures before the worker's first scrape after a restart are missed. Documents by outcome per run has the exact count.

panels.title: Index write failures
panels.description: Vector or graph write attempts in the last 24 hours that failed while the document stayed findable through the other index.

panels.title: Stale schedules
panels.description: Unpaused schedules with no completed run in 26 hours: the Sync missed or stale alert.

targets.expr: count((sum by (schedule_id) (increase(harborrag_temporal_scheduled_runs_total{outcome=~"completed|partial"}[26h])) == 0) and on (schedule_id) (harborrag_temporal_schedule_paused == 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cost per 1k docs
panels.description: Ingestion's model cost per 1,000 documents indexed over the dashboard's range: mostly embeddings. Multiply by a corpus size to price a forced re-sync. Cost is what the LiteLLM proxy reports from its price list: an estimate, not the invoice. Self-hosted models report 0. There is no tenant label, so cost cannot be split per tenant.

panels.title: Firing offline alerts
panels.description: Firing alerts labelled side=offline, critical first. Each alert names its runbook.

panels.title: Did it run and what changed
Source runs
panels.description: The status of each source's latest run over time, one row per source scope. A run shorter than the query step can fall between two samples; Documents by outcome per run lists every finished run.

targets.expr:
max by (tenant, source_scope_id) (
  harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="completed"} * 1
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="partial"} * 2
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="failed"} * 3
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="cancelled"} * 4
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="running"} * 5
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="paused"} * 6
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="pending"} * 7
)

panels.title: Documents by outcome per run
panels.description: Documents each of the 20 latest finished runs published, found unchanged and failed, newest first, from the worker's ingestion.source_finalized lines. A large unchanged share proves incremental sync works.

panels.title: Documents processed by outcome
panels.description: Documents per interval: activated (indexed), skipped (unchanged) and failed. The width of a run's bars is how long it took; their height is its throughput.

panels.title: Model cost per interval
panels.description: Ingestion's model cost per interval by operation, lined up with the run markers. Cost is what the LiteLLM proxy reports from its price list: an estimate, not the invoice. Self-hosted models report 0. There is no tenant label, so cost cannot be split per tenant.

panels.title: p95 per stage, in pipeline order
panels.description: p95 per ingestion stage over the range, in pipeline order, so the stalled stage stands out.

panels.title: Partial index failures
panels.description: Failed vector (qdrant_write) and graph (falkordb_write) write attempts.

panels.title: Connector errors and 429s
panels.description: Non-2xx connector responses per interval. 4xx is usually a credential or permission problem (401 after a token expires); many 429s: slow the schedule down.

panels.title: Parse time by parser, p95
panels.description: p95 parse time per parser family.

panels.title: Activity failures by activity type
panels.description: Failed Temporal activity attempts, from the worker's SDK metrics. Retries follow retries.discovery and retries.document in config/temporal.yaml; a permanent error, such as a rejected document, fails on its first attempt. The Failed documents logs say why.

panels.title: Activity slots in use per task queue
panels.description: Most activity slots each task queue's worker used per interval, against worker.max_concurrent_activities in config/temporal.yaml (dashed). A queue pinned at the line during a run is limited by that setting. Values of 1 or less are hidden: an open poll alone holds one slot, so an idle queue shows nothing.

panels.title: Temporal pickup delay per task queue
panels.description: p95 time an activity waited for a free worker slot, per task queue. It rises when slots are full. The line is the Temporal backlog alert level. A stopped worker reports nothing: check the worker container.

panels.title: Workflows completed and failed
panels.description: Temporal workflow completions and failures per interval, by workflow type.

panels.title: Last sync per source and tenant
panels.description: Sources by time since their last completed or partial run, stalest first; a source that never completed one comes first.

targets.expr:
max by (tenant, source_scope_id, connector_type) (
  harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="completed"} * 1
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="partial"} * 2
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="failed"} * 3
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="cancelled"} * 4
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="running"} * 5
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="paused"} * 6
  or harborrag_ingestion_source_last_run_status{tenant=~"$tenant",connector_type=~"$connector",status="pending"} * 7
)

panels.title: Failed documents
panels.description: Failed documents, failed activities and failed runs, with their error type, code and stage. Each line carries its trace ID; open it to see where the run failed.
